name: Blood & Shadow 2

features.name: Ritual Bar
features.description: Five collection levels that unlock the grid.

features.name: Sticky drop wilds
features.description: Wilds fall to the bottom and stay until they win.

review:
Blood & Shadow 2 is a 5x5 occult sequel where the bottom row starts locked and full of wilds. A Ritual Bar beneath the grid collects through five levels, and each level unlocks more of the board and awards +2 Candle Spins, with +6 spins for reaching Reign of Terror Spins.

In the bonuses, wilds drop to the bottom of their reel and stay sticky until they're part of a win. xSplit can split rows or reels to multiply symbols. Nolimit rates it Extreme volatility, with a 16,161x maximum, much more aggressive than the original.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
